definitions.explanation: The act of removing one thing and putting another in its place. Used for replacing people, items, or contents.
The process of one group leaving and another arriving, such as audiences between shows or employees rotating in shifts.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {入|い}れ{替|か}える (to replace, swap). Common in both everyday and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入|い}れ{替|か}え⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: turnover system (audiences must leave between shows)
- {入|い}れ{替|か}え⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧: relegation/promotion playoff
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{入|い}れ{替|か}え: complete turnover
- ⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入|い}れ{替|か}え: membership change; roster shake-up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧: exchange — mutual giving and receiving between two parties
- ⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧: rotation — taking turns in a role or position
- {差|さ}し{替|か}え: replacement — substituting one item for another, often documents or components
